name: Dracul Tremblay
source:
Having grown online notoriety for his extensive campaigns with his younger sisters, Dracul has maintained a following even a few years into having such a niche title. He's got a rather eccentric and loud personality, often acting without thinking and he's very quick to take charge of a situation to prevent others getting hurt.

Despite this, Dracul is one of the more insecure Prisoners- worrying often if his talent means others won't take him seriously. He feels an immense amount of pressure to both be interesting and responsible. A few of the Prisoners have become quite dependent on him, while others see him as a loser who still lives with his mother and plays with toys.

He seemed to completely change when confronted with his crime, I'm unsure if his guiIt is performative or not, but there was clearly a lot of guilt associated with it.

[From the [url=https://danganronpa-fanganprojects.fandom.com/wiki/Dracul_Tremblay_(Danganronpa_Antebellum:_LOCKDOWN)]name[/url]]
